candidates.name: Practice Guide 41 supplement 6 - voluntary application to note overriding interests
verified_facts: Certain overriding interests can be voluntarily noted on a developing estate register.
Interests affecting multiple plots may be noted before development transactions proceed.
Once entered, those interests become apparent from official copies of the developer register.
semantic_limits: A registered or overriding interest is legal/register evidence and does not itself provide parcel boundary coordinates or terrain elevation.

candidates.name: Practice guide 11: inspection and application for official copies
verified_facts: Official copies of registers and title plans are available and are timed and dated to represent the register/title extent at a specific time.
HM Land Registry distinguishes electronic view products from official copies for evidential purposes.
A certificate of inspection can confirm a plot is within a vendor title when the relevant approved estate-plan process applies.
semantic_limits: Official-copy status strengthens registration evidence but does not convert title-plan graphics into bare-earth elevation measurements or exact surveyed boundary coordinates.
